newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech tar maker sees 1996 profits dip.
newsitem.headline: Czech tar maker sees 1996 profits dip.

text.p: Czech tar and chemical producer DEZA a.s. said on Thursday that preliminary results show net 1996 profit dropped to 145 million crowns from 217 million in the previous calendar year.

DEZA spokesman Karel Jiricek said also that pre-tax profit for 1996 fell to 214 million crowns from 335 million on total turnover of 3.072 billion crowns which dropped from 3.471 billion, according to results which are subject to an audit.
The company has not yet decided on a possible dividend on 1996 profit, Jiricek said. It paid a gross dividend of 60 crowns per share on 1995 profit.
The main shareholder of DEZA, based in the central-eastern town of Valasske Mezirici, is the SPIF Cesky fund and the IPF Komercni Banky funds, each with 20 percent stakes.
